video.title: AI欧腐《狼王的挚爱人鱼/The Wolf King's Beloved Merman》
video.desc:
听说是RYAN & ETHAN建模二搭 我就翻了下
In a fantasy world of wolf clans and merfolk realms, Alpha, the rightful Wolf King, shares a quiet, passionate love with Luca, a soft-spoken pureblood merman — until a political poisoning leaves Alpha comatose for three years. To keep him alive, Luca sacrifices his own merfolk blood and valuable scales to pay for the rare life-saving elixir, enduring poverty, mockery and cruelty from his greedy, status-obsessed relatives. When Alpha finally awakens, his dormant wolf spirit surges back, and he swears to protect the man who saved him. As the traitorous wolf lord Damian and the scheming noble Anna plot to seize the throne, kidnap Luca, and pass Anna off as Alpha’s childhood rescuer, the long-buried truth of a twenty-year-old sea rescue unravels — revealing Luca was the little merman who saved Alpha all along. After a daring rescue at an underground auction, Alpha claims his soulmate and crowns Luca his royal Luna at their wedding.

在一个狼族与人鱼王国并存的奇幻世界里，正统狼王Alpha与温柔寡言的纯血人鱼Luca相爱，感情低调而炽热。然而一场政治阴谋中的投毒，让Alpha昏迷了整整三年。为了保住他的性命，Luca不惜献出自己的人鱼之血和珍贵的鳞片，换取稀有的救命灵药，并忍受着贫困、嘲讽，以及那些贪婪势利的亲戚的百般欺辱。
当Alpha终于苏醒，沉睡已久的狼魂汹涌回归，他发誓要守护这个救了自己的男人。与此同时，叛徒狼族领主Damian与工于心计的贵族Anna密谋篡夺王位、绑架Luca，并让Anna冒充Alpha童年时的救命恩人。随着阴谋展开，一桩尘封二十年的海上救援真相逐渐浮出水面：原来Luca正是当年救下Alpha的那条小人鱼。
在地下拍卖会上的一场惊险营救之后，Alpha认定了自己的灵魂伴侣，并在婚礼上为Luca加冕，封他为自己的王室Luna。
